summary: Correct, minimal fix that short-circuits ModelBackend.authenticate() when username or password is None, avoiding a useless DB query and needless password hasher run. Matches the issue's recommendation and Django conventions; no correctness or compatibility problems.

issues.description: Behavior changes when password is None but username is valid: previously it ran the timing-mask hasher; now returns None early. Outcome is equivalent (auth still fails) and the timing-mask is intentionally dropped per the issue rationale, so no real regression.
